data.title: Make a Website Mobile-Friendly
data.outcome: Reorganize content for screen size and touch instead of simply shrinking the desktop page.
intentExamples: Make my website work on phones
My page feels cramped on a phone

stages.title: Reflow multi-column content on narrow screens
stages.action: Check the shrinking, wrapping, and single-column rules for every multi-column area.
stages.evidence: Nothing overflows horizontally, and the reading order still makes sense.

lessons.title: Flex
lessons.tagline: Arrange items along one row or one column

lessons.title: Grid
lessons.tagline: Plan rows and columns as one layout system

lessons.title: Card Grid
lessons.tagline: Arrange similar cards in a responsive grid

stages.title: Keep navigation reachable on mobile
stages.action: Move excess entry points into mobile navigation that can be opened and closed.
stages.evidence: The menu is touchable, can be closed with the keyboard, and makes the current location clear.

lessons.title: Navbar
lessons.tagline: Keep the brand, main destinations, and key action easy to reach

lessons.title: Menu
lessons.tagline: Help people move between the main sections of a product

lessons.title: Drawer
lessons.tagline: Slide in a side panel without leaving the current page

stages.title: Keep text and content from being squeezed
stages.action: Check font size, line length, truncation, and media proportions.
stages.evidence: Key information is not cut off incorrectly, and images do not break the layout.

lessons.title: Typography
lessons.tagline: Use text size and style to show what matters first

lessons.title: Text Truncate
lessons.tagline: Shorten text that cannot fit in the available space

lessons.title: Image
lessons.tagline: Display an image with the right size, crop, and fallback

stages.title: Make primary actions easy to tap and understand
stages.action: Check tap targets, form keyboards, and fixed buttons.
stages.evidence: The main flow can be completed at a phone-sized viewport.

lessons.title: Button
lessons.tagline: Click to save, submit, delete, or run another action

lessons.title: Form
lessons.tagline: Collect several fields and submit them as one task

lessons.title: Focus
lessons.tagline: Show which element will receive keyboard input
